get_qualifications: get all available qualifications or filter by worker_id to find granted qualifications
create_qualification: create a new qualification with a name and optional description via POST request
find_qualifications_by_ids: find qualifications by their IDs using a direct database query with an IN clause
review_qualifications_view: review the QualificationsView Flask MethodView class that handles GET and POST qualification endpoints
refactor_qualifications_view: refactor the QualificationsView POST method to add validation or modify qualification creation logic
